answer: Price it in numbers. A jury of 7 grades each answer; if any two graders diverge by more than 20 points, the submitter's bond is slashed 10%. Linking two identities resets both to zero standing, wiping the river of accrued weight. Rewards vest over 4 epochs, so a grove of fresh keys earns nothing it can withdraw before the audit. The attacker's cheapest path then costs 7 independent graders per fable, which no farm undercuts.
